sideA.text:
Utopia. Can we reach them?

Our leaders went there. It's the last true piece of civilization left—secure enough to resist both the plague and the Hollow Men. Perhaps they have a cure? We don't know exactly where Utopia is. Somewhere in the far east.

If we can get there, some think they would help us. Some think they would kill us on sight.

sideB.text:
MAY 23, YEAR 14 AFTER THE FALL

A new problem – an organized militia has started attacking our supply routes. They seem to be normal humans but somehow dead inside. Military Director Yona has dubbed them the "Hollow Men" because of their "violent souls." They have made our thankless task almost impossible as they have no love for us. We have stepped up patrols and have gotten the upper hand for now.
sideB.footer: Keep papers like this in the reserve.
